cd /workspace/mytests && timeout 900 python3 - <<'EOF'
from harness import *
import json, time, subprocess, sys, resource, os
# Build a near-maximum batch
ncases = 2000
frames_per_case = 10          # 20000 frames
cases = []
for i in range(ncases):
    fr = []
    for j in range(frames_per_case):
        if j == 0:
            fr.append({"Type":"headers","End_Stream":False,"data_to_transfered":[["k%d"%k,"v%d"%k] for k in range(1)]})
        elif j % 3 == 0:
            fr.append({"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ b'payload' * %d }}" % (j+1),"End_Stream": (j==frames_per_case-1)})
        elif j % 3 == 1:
            fr.append({"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":"dg<<random_string>>"})
        else:
            fr.append({"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":j})
    fr.append({"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[["end","1"]]})
    cases.append({"name":"case_%d"%i,"frames":fr,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/t%d"%i,"host":"h%d.example"%i}})
events = []
for i in range(10000):
    if i % 1000 == 999: continue
    events.append({"at":i%97,"kind":"headers","stream":4*(i%ncases),"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":False})
events.append({"at":10**6,"kind":"close"})
channels = []
per_channel = 20000//256 + 1
for c in range(256):
    parts = []
    for p in range(per_channel):
        owner = "case_%d" % ((c*7+p) % ncases)
        parts.append({"case":owner,"data":"{{ b'GET /t' + b'%d' + b' HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h.example\\r\\nContent-Length: 4\\r\\n\\r\\nbody' % %d }}" % ((c*7+p)%ncases)})
    channels.append({"name":"chan_%d"%c,"parts":parts})
d = {"seed":"bigseed","definitions":[["p%d"%i, "b'x' * %d" % (i+1)] for i in range(100)],
     "timeout_ms":1000,"cases":cases,"events":events,"channels":channels}
s = json.dumps(d)
print('json bytes', len(s), 'items', sum(len(c['frames']) for c in cases)+len(events)+sum(len(c['parts']) for c in channels))
t=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','main.py'], cwd='/workspace/project', input=s.encode(),
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
el = time.time()-t
out = p.stdout.decode()
print('elapsed %.2fs'%el, 'rc', p.returncode, 'out bytes', len(out), 'stderr', p.stderr.decode()[-300:])
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('child maxrss MB', ru.ru_maxrss/1024)
o = json.loads(out)
print('cases', len(o.get('cases',[])), 'channels', len(o.get('channels',[])))
print(json.dumps(o['cases'][0])[:400])
print(json.dumps(o['channels'][0]['requests'][0])[:400])
EOF
